title: The Man of Lawlessness and the Lord's Return
description: Paul describes the sequence of events before the day of the Lord: first comes the apostasy, and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed. He exalts himself above everything called God and sets himself in God's temple. His coming is by Satan's power with signs and false wonders, but the Lord Jesus will destroy him by the brightness of his return. The chapter ends with comfort and an encouragement to the chosen to stand firm in the truth.
